text:
viv: FYI deploy-bot blocked promo for analytics-service. It flagged a PVC size growth + a CRD apiVersion bump in a transitive subchart (redis-operator).

noah: link to diff?

viv: pasted: 
```
charts/redis-operator: 2.2.0 -> 3.0.0
~ charts/redis-operator.values.persistence.size: 2Gi -> 8Gi
~ charts/redis-operator.crds.redis.ai/v1alpha1 -> redis.ai/v1
```

sasha: that's a big size jump and a crd upgrade. on-prem clusters won't accept v1 CRD. Shouldn't promote.

deploy-bot: Promotion halted: subchart compatibility check failed. Recommendation: revert subchart bump and add `persistence.skipResize: true`.

noah: propose: pin redis-operator to 2.2.0, set skipResize true, and add release note: "Deferred redis-operator upgrade (PVC/CRD) to scheduled maintenance." Then create MAINT ticket.

viv: agreed. i'll open a PR to pin and add the skip flag.

release-manager: please @noah add an entry to release-notes and link the maintenance ticket once created.

noah: PR created: https://git.internal/r/infra/analytics-release/pull/301 - includes helm.lock pin and values change. deploy-bot will retry after merge.

deploy-bot: Redeploy triggered on canary. Post-deploy: pods ready, no PVC events, metrics stable.

viv: filing MAINT-209 for full upgrade. filing INFRA-518 to add preflight rule for >3x pvc size deltas and CRD apiVersion changes.

sasha: good call. adding a short rollback snippet to the release PR in case of unexpected PVC events.

noah: merged and promoted. release-manager: please mark as cleared.

release-manager: cleared. thanks everyone.
